column1: # This file defines the compute options of the external state variables
# Commented lines and blank lines are ignored
# The order in which variables are computed is defined by their
#   in this file, where the first defined SV is computed first.
# There are three compute options specifiable in this files:
#   computeIterOption  (optional) computed each timestep, defaults to first iteration if undefined
#   computeDateOption  defines which date(s) to compute state variable
#   computePassOption  (optional) multiple passes for each simulation, defaults to first pass if undefined
# The "computeIterOption" dictates which compute iteration the state variable is evaluated.
#  There can be multiple compute iterations within each time step and
#  it may not be necessary to compute each state variable multiple times for
#  "ignore" will skip computing the state variable altogether
